newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe industrial shares recover, market strong.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe industrial shares recover, market strong.

text.p: Zimbabwean industrial shares, enjoying solid support from local investors, recovered on Thursday from a slight overnight jolt to continue a rain-powered bull run that has outlasted many predictions.

The key 57-counter industrial index climbed 8.72 points to end the day at 10,284.62 following some gains in several second-tier stocks, including tyre-manufacturer Dunlop and coffee and tea grower, Eastern Highlands Plantations, which added 10 cents each to 250 and 160.
"There is some strong support coming to the bottom, and some price-correction going on at the top," one broker said.
Two bluchips -- banking group Barclays and sugar producer Hippo Valley -- traded 50 and 25 cents down respectively at 3,550 and 1,500.

"It's the sort of thing we are expecting now...but on the whole, the market remains strong," he said of the Zimbabwe Stock Exchange which has climbed to record levels in the past three months, flourishing on heavy rains lashing the agriculture-based country.
On the secondary mining portfolio, gold producer Falcon traded 10 cents higher at 100 and helped the seven-share mining index to rise to 1,064.05.
